integrity_notes: The polynomial invariance and discriminant have a standalone exact-arithmetic checker. The line-bundle obstruction and Picard-rank arguments are proved geometrically. Fano family identification uses cited published Mori-Mukai classification. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: The result exhibits order-two Amitsur obstructions for a nonempty two-dimensional parameter locus. It does not attain or exclude the published order-four general upper bound, does not classify all finite group actions or individual isomorphism types, and has not undergone independent audit.
title: A nonzero Amitsur obstruction throughout an invariant elliptic blow-up family
